convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iBands indicator. Simple Bollinger Band breakout entry with fixed SL/TP. Fixed lot or risk-percent sizing. No external .mqh dependencies for trading logic. No grid, martingale, or hedging.

other_exits: Close long when price touches or crosses above Upper Band
Close short when price touches or crosses below Lower Band

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative LotOrRisk value = fixed lots (absolute value); positive LotOrRisk value = risk percentage of balance for SL-based sizing

custom_logic_notes: EA opens up to N positions in the same direction. Each new position is opened on a new bar when price is outside the Bollinger Bands. Positions are closed when price reaches the opposite band or when SL/TP is hit. The 'N positions' feature allows stacking multiple entries as price continues beyond the bands, each on a successive new bar. Digit adjustment: SL/TP values in points are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 to account for 5-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: 1. SL/TP pip values need digit adjustment logic: if point < 0.001, multiply by 10 to get proper point values. 2. The conditional lot sizing (negative=fixed, positive=risk%) must be implemented with two code paths. 3. New bar detection must be implemented using bar time comparison. 4. Position counting per symbol and direction is required for the N-positions gate. 5. Entry uses previous bar band values (shift=1) vs current price - must replicate exactly. 6. Built-in Bollinger Bands equivalent available in most Python trading libraries (pandas-ta, ta-lib).
